verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
MUJAGUZE nno!
Mmwe-abantu mwenna
Yesu Mulokozi ye yajja gye tuli

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Mujaguze nno!
Omusana gwaka,
Ebiro byayita eby'obutamanya.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Mujaguze nno!
Omusaayi-gwayika,
Ogwa Yesu Mukama-ogunaaza-ebibi.

verse.name: v7
verse.lines:
Mujaguze nno!
Atusonyiwa-era,
Omutuukirivu yatufiirira ffe.

verse.name: v9
verse.lines:
Mujaguze nno!
Okufa kufudde,
Yesu ye yakuwangulua n'azuukira.

verse.name: v11
verse.lines:
Mujaguze nno!
Yesu atufuga,
Atufuga fenna-era-atuwolereza.

verse.name: v13
verse.lines:
Mujaguze nno!
Ajja kudda nate,
Ajja kudda nate n'ekitiibwa Yesu.
